title: Spain counts the cost of 'nightmare' wildfire summer
summary: The country's farming and tourism sectors have been heavily affected by a spate of blazes.

title: Jerome Cohen, Lawyer Who Saw a Future in China, Dies at 95
summary: After pioneering the study of Chinese law in America, he was among the first foreigners to practice commercial law in China, and spoke out about human rights.

title: Fed Cuts Rates for First Time This Year
summary: The Federal Reserve lowered rates by a quarter point, but one governor voted for a bigger cut. Balancing persistent inflation and a weaker labor market was “a challenging situation,” the central bank chair said.

title: Japan's Konbini convenience stores coming to the U.S.
summary: In Japan, Konbini convenience stores have become part of the country's infrastructure, offering fresh meals delivered several times a day, tickets to concerts and museums, and even services like bill payments. Now the model is coming to the U.S., where critics question whether it will resonate with American customers.
